description: StEER - Puerto Rico Earthquake December 2019 to January 2020: Field Assessment Structural Team (FAST) Data Report is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "field recon", published or maintained by Tracy Kijewski-Correa, University of Notre Dame (nd.edu). This project encompasses the products of StEER's Level 2 response to the Puerto Rico Earthquake from December 2019 to January 2020. The main event, a Mw 6.4 quake, occurred on January 7th, accompanied by numerous aftershocks. The governor reported one casualty and eight injuries, declaring a State of Emergency. Coverage: Puerto Rico. DesignSafe files it as a "field recon" project. Keywords: StEER, reconnaissance, earthquake, Puerto Rico Earthquake, Puerto Rico, Level 2. Published 2024-03-04. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
